summary: Pingora gateway (hyperscale profile) built as a separate workspace (LB, health checks, pooled upstreams) and measured direct vs proxied vs nginx at equal workers. Result: a proxy hop roughly halves trivial-endpoint throughput on a shared host (+0.5 ms p50); Pingora ~ nginx; ~45 us CPU/request. Decision: available, off by default; adopt for programmable edge logic on dedicated nodes (ADR 0009).
